title: ZDD repo config (zdd/config.json)
description: Per-repo ZDD configuration: which adapter to run, where the artifacts live, and adapter-specific source paths. Artifact CONTENTS never live here — this is the small, portable config tier only.

adapter.description: Name of the deriver adapter to run (selected by name from the engine's static registry — never a path).

name.description: Display name for the indexes (agent-index heading, human-index title).

repoBase.description: GitHub tree URL prefix for source links in the human index, e.g. https://github.com/org/repo/tree/main/. Empty = relative links.

baseBranch.description: The branch PRs merge into. Freshness diffs and the renderer's changed-set highlight key on origin/<baseBranch>.

paths.description: Where each artifact lives. Defaults are the self-contained zdd/* layout; point elsewhere only if adopting an existing glossary/ADR directory.

bundleDir.description: The folder graph node ids are relative to — the zdd/ folder itself.

adapterOptions.description: Adapter-specific source configuration (shape depends on the chosen adapter). For nextjs-supabase: appDir, apiPrefix, middlewarePath, authPatterns, migrationNamespaces, externalBuckets, refs, srcAliasRoot (where the tsconfig @/ alias points; default appDir's parent).

storeChanges.description: Set false to render with no git dependency — drops the 'what just changed' highlight from the human index.

agentIndex.description: Renderer options for the agent index (e.g. the blockquote summary line).

viewer.description: Human-index viewer options (focus, auth hubs, non-area tags).
